overview_description.description:
Integration Labs (formerly RootFi) is a data integration platform that makes it simple, safe and reliable for companies to access their customers' accounting, e-commerce, and payment data.

We provide a simple and well-documented Unified API that product teams can instantly start using to read and write data to over 20+ platforms like Quickbooks, Shopify and Stripe.

Companies use Integration Labs to underwrite credit risk, automate accounting, surface business insights or create new business tools.
